termsScopeNote: Official terms URL: https://www.spatial.nsw.gov.au/products_and_services/web_services/terms_and_conditions. Sections 1.1-1.2 scope the SWS as DCS Spatial Services-provided online spatial data access and bind use to terms. Clause 2.1.6 reads: “use any robot, spider, site search/retrieval application, or other device to retrieve or index any portion of the SWS.” This expressly mentions retrieval separately from indexing, so a plain reading is broader than website crawling and includes automated API retrieval; this is an interpretation, not formal legal advice. Search result identifies maps.six layer as the catalogued NSW Cadastre Web Service; no separate current freely licensed, service-compatible download located.
